channel.title: Central African Republic - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Central African Republic, every source cited.

item.title: Rotary Club supports polio response in Bangui
item.description: Community health workers trained to identify and report suspected polio cases following detection of two cases in Ouango.

item.title: Alumni donate 32 novels to Bangui school
item.description: The Association of Former LAENS Students provided literary works to enhance the school's library resources.

item.title: Amnesty International warns of special court closure
item.description: The Central African Republic's special court risks closure by 2028 due to a lack of funding.
